source.authority: SQLite terminal SimulationState loaded read-only through sqlite-run-reader.mjs; the audit never advances or mutates a run.

method.invariant: Each fact resolves an active-established companion agreement, proposal/establishment/birth sources, twelve unique unconsumed child co-residence months, a non-parent adult, and bilateral relation cache sources.
method.eligibleTransition: At birth, a co-located age>=16 non-parent adult in an already established companion agreement with a genetic parent begins as newborn->adult sourced trust only; a valid household fact makes the pair bilateral. Agreements established later in childhood are reported separately.
method.controls: Genetic parents and co-located adults who never overlap a child-age established companion agreement with a genetic parent must receive no household-co-residence fact.
method.observerBoundary: Counts and validation only; no result is fed back into needs, options, relationships, or civilization indices.
